camera.motion: assumed static: the floor is untextured uniform grey (~136/255), so no background features exist to measure a shift; nothing indicates panning (both walkers move smoothly in straight lines, the median background is clean).
camera.view: top-down (nadir) perspective view of a ground plane. Image x = walking direction (people move toward -x, right to left); image y = sideways on the floor.
camera.perspective: Visible radial parallax: a walker's head is displaced away from the image centre relative to the body (head right of torso at x~1350, centred at x~960, left of torso at x~300). Head-track path is ~8-9% longer than mask-centroid path. Apparent body size is constant (head diameter ~43 px, shoulder span ~145 px throughout), i.e. both people stay at the same depth; no horizon or vanishing points.
